preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the TetherToken to initiate transfer
Contract must not be paused (paused == false)
Attacker must not be blacklisted (isBlackListed[attacker] == false)

exploit_hint: The contract's transfer function has a critical ERC20 non-conformity: it subtracts the full _value from sender's balance but only adds (value - fee) to recipient's balance. This creates a discrepancy where the contract's total supply doesn't match the sum of balances. Exploit by transferring tokens to yourself or another address you control - the fee portion will be lost from circulation but your balance will correctly reflect the sendAmount. The vulnerability allows economic gain because the fee calculation is flawed and can be manipulated through repeated transfers to increase your effective balance relative to the total supply.
